annotations.title: Open an AnimatedWebs template in a builder

description: Returns links that start a new project from one AnimatedWebs template's build prompt in Lovable, v0 and Bolt; nothing is created until the user opens a link. Use it to hand a template to a hosted AI builder; use get_template with include_prompt true instead to build it yourself in the current project. Same access rule and fair-use cap as get_template with include_prompt: free templates need any signed-in account; a Pro template is included with Pro and Lifetime or spends one Prompt Pack credit on first use (later calls are free). The prompt is embedded in each link, so v0 and Bolt links are left out when longer than 7,000 characters; lovable is always present. Unknown slugs return an error. Example: {"slug":"aurora-site"}.

slug.description: Template slug exactly as returned by search_catalog (kind templates), e.g. 'aurora-site'.

name: open_builder
